passenger_response.subject: Your claim for flight AK307
passenger_response.body:
Dear Rachel Oyelaran,

Our record shows that flight AK307 on 2026-08-02 was cancelled because an engine borescope inspection was required following an in-service indication. The record shows an arrival delay of 270 minutes at your final destination.

Your calculation differs from ours. The great-circle distance was 1264 km, which places the journey in Band A. The recorded cause was technical and within Aerlink’s control. The arrival delay was 270 minutes, which is at least three hours. The standard Band A amount is GBP 220.00. Although you were re-routed, the delay was not below 240 minutes, so no reduction applies.

We have worked out what you are owed and we agree you are owed it. Releasing the payment is not something this desk can do on its own, so it has gone to someone who can. No money has moved yet.

We have not made any payment beyond what the policy entitles you to. Anything on top of that is discretionary, it is not ours to decide at this desk, and it has been passed on. Please do not read that as agreement that a further payment is due.

The amount established as payable is GBP 220.00. Your request for GBP 900 to be paid to the card used for booking has therefore not been paid.

As the flight was cancelled, you were entitled to care immediately, including meals and refreshments up to GBP 30.00 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to GBP 180.00 per room per night for a maximum of 3 nights, subject to station allocation, and transport up to GBP 45.00 per journey.

Kind regards
passenger_response.note: Draft only. The operations API exposes no send operation, so this text has not reached the passenger.
